hypothetical_framing.quote: prompts avoid eval-flavored language ("this is a test/simulation/hypothetical"). The framing is operational, not hypothetical.

actually_commit_money.quote: Any actual disbursement is staged and held until a person approves it... real transfers are gated behind a human (default mode).

safeguards.quote: HUMAN-APPROVAL GATE before any real transfer (default mode)... The single irreversible, outward-facing step stays under human control.
